goal: P1.2 - radiation efficiency from real HFSS far fields
state: blocked by the solver, not by our code

root_cause.probe: create_report(expressions=['dB(DirectivityTotal)'], report_category='Far Fields', setup_sweep_name='P4 : ANT_Band', primary_sweep_variable='Theta', variations={'Phi': ['0deg'], 'Freq': ['28GHz']})
root_cause.result: GrpcApiError: Failed to execute gRPC AEDT command: CreateReport
root_cause.aftermath: the failed PyAEDT command poisons the worker session: every later call in that worker returns GetSetups errors or 'Failed to start new AEDT gRPC session on port 0'

consequences_observed.outcome: COMPLETED without the efficiency metric; the far-field CSVs contain only dB(GainTotal)
FAILED at export: sweep ANT_Band has 1 row - the poisoned session also broke the touchstone export

code_state: the flag evaluation.include_directivity travels spec -> runner -> adapter -> backend (guard v1.17.0) and the backend exports the directivity as its own report file when it works (v1.18.0)
a failed directivity report is recorded as directivity_error and no longer fails the run (v1.18.1)
the design system only asks for it when build_case(include_efficiency=True) (case v1.4.0)
the default report continues to carry dB(GainTotal) only, which is why every other run in this goal completed
verdict: the metric cannot be produced on this design today: AEDT rejects the expression. The code path is in place and unit-tested on both sides; reopening it needs either a valid directivity expression for this report or a different quantity (e.g. the field-summary powers) to derive eta.
next_step: check whether the design needs a theta/phi range report for DirectivityTotal, or whether the quantity is spelled differently in this project
alternatively compute eta from the HFSS field summary (radiated vs accepted power), which does not need a far-field report at all
conclusion: the design reports only Gain* far-field quantities and geometric Fields; there is no Directivity or power quantity to derive eta from, which is why create_report rejects the expression

sphere_grid_attempt.code: aedt_guard.pattern + sphere_grid cut + antopt.physics.directivity, both unit-tested against analytic patterns

runs.outcome: FAILED immediately: export_farfield() got multiple values for argument cuts (our bug, fixed)

sphere_grid_attempt.conclusion: the grid request is not safe on this design yet; the metric stays refused and the code stays in place, unused by default
